say:1:1037018001:1.text: The corruption is said to have begun in Rainford. The villagers there were forced to flee.
say:1:1037018001:1.source_cn: 据说腐化始于丛林和山脉交界的沐霖村。那里的村民都被迫从...

say:2:1037018002:1.text: If Eomir hadn't been stopped, would Slopeville have turned out the same as Rainford?
say:2:1037018002:1.source_cn: 如果……如果伊米尔的计划没被发现，南坡村是否也会和沐霖...

say:3:1037018003:1.text: Everyone would have been forced to run and hide... to abandon their homes.
say:3:1037018003:1.source_cn: 大家被迫逃出自己的村庄，逃出丛林……然后失去故乡。

say:4:1037018004:1.text: I get chills down my spine just thinking about it.
say:4:1037018004:1.source_cn: 这种事情，只是想想都会让我的脊背发凉。
